verses.original: Καὶ ἦλθεν εἷς ἐκ τῶν ἑπτὰ ἀγγέλων τῶν ἐχόντων τὰς ἑπτὰ φιάλας καὶ ἐλάλησεν μετ’ ἐμοῦ λέγων Δεῦρο δείξω σοι τὸ κρίμα τῆς πόρνης τῆς μεγάλης τῆς καθημένης ἐπὶ ὑδάτων πολλῶν
verses.transliteration: Kai ēlthen heis ek tōn hepta angelōn tōn echontōn tas hepta phialas kai elalēsen met’ emou legōn Deuro deixō soi to krima tēs pornēs tēs megalēs tēs kathēmenēs epi hydatōn pollōn
verses.literal: Then one of the seven angels with the seven bowls came and said to me Come I will show you the punishment of the great prostitute who sits on many waters
verses.literalPt: Veio um dos sete anjos que tinham as sete taças e falou comigo: Vem cá, e mostrar-te-ei a sentença da grande prostituta que está sentada sobre muitas águas.

verses.original: μεθ’ ἧς ἐπόρνευσαν οἱ βασιλεῖς τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐμεθύσθησαν οἱ κατοικοῦντες τὴν γῆν ἐκ τοῦ οἴνου τῆς πορνείας αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: meth’ hēs eporneusan hoi basileis tēs gēs kai emethysthēsan hoi katoikountes tēn gēn ek tou oinou tēs porneias autēs
verses.literal: The kings of the earth were immoral with her and those who dwell on the earth were intoxicated with the wine of her immorality
verses.literalPt: Com ela fornicaram os reis da terra, e os habitantes da terra foram embebedados com o vinho da sua fornicação.

verses.original: Καὶ ἀπήνεγκέν με εἰς ἔρημον ἐν Πνεύματι καὶ εἶδον γυναῖκα καθημένην ἐπὶ θηρίον κόκκινον γέμοντα ὀνόματα βλασφημίας ἔχων κεφαλὰς ἑπτὰ καὶ κέρατα δέκα
verses.transliteration: Kai apēnenken me eis erēmon en Pneumati kai eidon gynaika kathēmenēn epi thērion kokkinon gemonta onomata blasphēmias echōn kephalas hepta kai kerata deka
verses.literal: And the angel carried me away . . . in the Spirit into a wilderness where I saw a woman sitting on a scarlet beast that was covered with blasphemous names and had seven heads and ten horns
verses.literalPt: Então, ele me levou, pelo Espírito, a um deserto. Vi uma mulher sentada sobre uma besta cor de escarlata, cheia de nomes de blasfêmia, que tinha sete cabeças e dez chifres.

verses.original: καὶ ἡ γυνὴ ἦν περιβεβλημένη πορφυροῦν καὶ κόκκινον καὶ κεχρυσωμένη χρυσίῳ καὶ λίθῳ τιμίῳ καὶ μαργαρίταις ἔχουσα ποτήριον χρυσοῦν ἐν τῇ χειρὶ αὐτῆς γέμον βδελυγμάτων καὶ τὰ ἀκάθαρτα τῆς πορνείας αὐτῆς
verses.transliteration: kai hē gynē ēn peribeblēmenē porphyroun kai kokkinon kai kechrysōmenē chrysiō kai lithō timiō kai margaritais echousa potērion chrysoun en tē cheiri autēs gemon bdelygmatōn kai ta akatharta tēs porneias autēs
verses.literal: The woman was dressed in purple and scarlet and adorned with gold and precious stones and pearls She held in her hand a golden cup full of abominations and the impurities of her sexual immorality
verses.literalPt: A mulher estava vestida de púrpura e de escarlata e adornada de ouro, de pedras preciosas e de pérolas, tendo na mão um cálice de ouro, cheio de abominações, isto é, as imundícias da sua fornicação.

verses.original: καὶ ἐπὶ τὸ μέτωπον αὐτῆς ὄνομα γεγραμμένον μυστήριον ΒΑΒΥΛΩΝ Η ΜΕΓΑΛΗ Η ΜΗΤΗΡ ΤΩΝ ΠΟΡΝΩΝ ΚΑΙ ΤΩΝ ΒΔΕΛΥΓΜΑΤΩΝ ΤΗΣ ΓΗΣ
verses.transliteration: kai epi to metōpon autēs onoma gegrammenon mystērion BABYLŌN Ē MEGALĒ Ē MĒTĒR TŌN PORNŌN KAI TŌN BDELYGMATŌN TĒS GĒS
verses.literal: And on her forehead a mysterious name was written BABYLON THE GREAT THE MOTHER OF PROSTITUTES AND OF THE ABOMINATIONS OF THE EARTH
verses.literalPt: Na sua testa estava escrito um nome: MISTÉRIO, A GRANDE BABILÔNIA, A MÃE DAS PROSTITUTAS E DAS ABOMINAÇÕES DA TERRA.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶδον τὴν γυναῖκα μεθύουσαν ἐκ τοῦ αἵματος τῶν ἁγίων καὶ ἐκ τοῦ αἵματος τῶν μαρτύρων Ἰησοῦ Καὶ ἐθαύμασα ἰδὼν αὐτὴν θαῦμα μέγα
verses.transliteration: Kai eidon tēn gynaika methyousan ek tou haimatos tōn hagiōn kai ek tou haimatos tōn martyrōn Iēsou Kai ethaumasa idōn autēn thauma mega
verses.literal: I could see that the woman was drunk with the blood of the saints and - - witnesses for Jesus And I was utterly amazed . . . . . . at the sight of her
verses.literalPt: Vi a mulher embriagada com o sangue dos santos e com o sangue dos mártires de Jesus. Quando a vi, fiquei espantado, com grande admiração.

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπέν μοι ὁ ἄγγελος Διὰ τί ἐθαύμασας ἐγὼ ἐρῶ σοι τὸ μυστήριον τῆς γυναικὸς καὶ τοῦ θηρίου τοῦ βαστάζοντος αὐτήν τοῦ ἔχοντος τὰς ἑπτὰ κεφαλὰς καὶ τὰ δέκα κέρατα
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen moi ho angelos Dia ti ethaumasas egō erō soi to mystērion tēs gynaikos kai tou thēriou tou bastazontos autēn tou echontos tas hepta kephalas kai ta deka kerata
verses.literal: Why . . . are you so amazed said the angel I will tell you the mystery of the woman and of the beast that carries her which has the seven heads and ten horns
verses.literalPt: O anjo perguntou-me: Por que te admiraste? Eu te direi o mistério da mulher e da besta que a leva, que tem as sete cabeças e os dez chifres.

verses.original: Τὸ θηρίον ὃ εἶδες ἦν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν καὶ μέλλει ἀναβαίνειν ἐκ τῆς ἀβύσσου καὶ εἰς ἀπώλειαν ὑπάγει καὶ θαυμασθήσονται οἱ κατοικοῦντες ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ὧν οὐ γέγραπται τὸ ὄνομα ἐπὶ τὸ βιβλίον τῆς ζωῆς ἀπὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου βλεπόντων τὸ θηρίον ὅτι ἦν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν καὶ παρέσται
verses.transliteration: To thērion ho eides ēn kai ouk estin kai mellei anabainein ek tēs abyssou kai eis apōleian hypagei kai thaumasthēsontai hoi katoikountes epi tēs gēs hōn ou gegraptai to onoma epi to biblion tēs zōēs apo katabolēs kosmou blepontōn to thērion hoti ēn kai ouk estin kai parestai
verses.literal: The beast that you saw it was and now is no more but is about to come up out of the Abyss and go to its destruction And those who dwell on the earth whose names were not written in the Book of Life from the foundation of the world will marvel when they see the beast that was and is not and yet will be
verses.literalPt: A besta que viste era, e já não é, e ela há de subir do abismo, e vai-se para a perdição. Os habitantes da terra, cujos nomes não estão escritos no livro da vida desde o princípio do mundo, se admirarão, vendo a besta que era, e que já não é, e que virá.

verses.original: Ὧδε ὁ νοῦς ὁ ἔχων σοφίαν αἱ ἑπτὰ κεφαλαὶ ἑπτὰ ὄρη εἰσίν ὅπου ἡ γυνὴ κάθηται ἐπ’ αὐτῶν
verses.transliteration: Hōde ho nous ho echōn sophian hai hepta kephalai hepta orē eisin hopou hē gynē kathētai ep’ autōn
verses.literal: This calls for a mind with wisdom The seven heads are seven mountains on which the woman sits
verses.literalPt: Aqui está a mente que tem sabedoria. As sete cabeças são sete montes, sobre os quais está sentada a mulher.

verses.original: καὶ βασιλεῖς ἑπτά εἰσιν οἱ πέντε ἔπεσαν ὁ εἷς ἔστιν ὁ ἄλλος οὔπω ἦλθεν καὶ ὅταν ἔλθῃ ὀλίγον αὐτὸν δεῖ μεῖναι
verses.transliteration: kai basileis hepta eisin hoi pente epesan ho heis estin ho allos oupō ēlthen kai hotan elthē oligon auton dei meinai
verses.literal: There are also seven kings Five have fallen one is and the other has not yet come But when he does come he must remain for only a little while
verses.literalPt: Elas são também sete reis; estão caídos cinco, existe um, e o outro ainda não veio. Quando vier, importa que dure pouco tempo.

verses.original: Καὶ τὸ θηρίον ὃ ἦν καὶ οὐκ ἔστιν καὶ αὐτὸς ὄγδοός ἐστιν καὶ ἐκ τῶν ἑπτά ἐστιν καὶ εἰς ἀπώλειαν ὑπάγει
verses.transliteration: Kai to thērion ho ēn kai ouk estin kai autos ogdoos estin kai ek tōn hepta estin kai eis apōleian hypagei
verses.literal: The beast that was and now is not is - an eighth king who belongs to the other seven and is going into destruction
verses.literalPt: A besta que era, e que já não é, é também o oitavo rei e é um dos sete; e vai-se para a perdição.

verses.original: καὶ τὰ δέκα κέρατα ἃ εἶδες δέκα βασιλεῖς εἰσιν οἵτινες βασιλείαν οὔπω ἔλαβον ἀλλὰ ἐξουσίαν ὡς βασιλεῖς μίαν ὥραν λαμβάνουσιν μετὰ τοῦ θηρίου
verses.transliteration: kai ta deka kerata ha eides deka basileis eisin hoitines basileian oupō elabon alla exousian hōs basileis mian hōran lambanousin meta tou thēriou
verses.literal: The ten horns you saw are ten kings who have not yet received a kingdom but will receive one hour of authority as kings along with the beast
verses.literalPt: Os dez chifres que viste são dez reis, os quais ainda não receberam o reino; mas eles receberam autoridade como reis, juntamente com a besta, por uma hora.

verses.original: οὗτοι μίαν γνώμην ἔχουσιν καὶ τὴν δύναμιν καὶ ἐξουσίαν αὐτῶν τῷ θηρίῳ διδόασιν
verses.transliteration: houtoi mian gnōmēn echousin kai tēn dynamin kai exousian autōn tō thēriō didoasin
verses.literal: These kings have one purpose to yield their power and authority to the beast
verses.literalPt: Estes estão todos de acordo e entregam o seu poder e autoridade à besta.

verses.original: Οὗτοι μετὰ τοῦ Ἀρνίου πολεμήσουσιν καὶ τὸ Ἀρνίον νικήσει αὐτούς ὅτι Κύριος κυρίων ἐστὶν καὶ Βασιλεὺς βασιλέων καὶ οἱ μετ’ αὐτοῦ κλητοὶ καὶ ἐκλεκτοὶ καὶ πιστοί
verses.transliteration: Houtoi meta tou Arniou polemēsousin kai to Arnion nikēsei autous hoti Kyrios kyriōn estin kai Basileus basileōn kai hoi met’ autou klētoi kai eklektoi kai pistoi
verses.literal: They will make war against the Lamb and the Lamb will triumph over them because He is Lord of lords and King of kings and He will be accompanied by His called and chosen and faithful ones
verses.literalPt: Eles pelejarão contra o Cordeiro, e o Cordeiro os vencerá, porque é Senhor dos senhores e Rei dos reis; também vencerão os que estão com ele, os chamados, os escolhidos e os fiéis.

verses.original: Καὶ λέγει μοι Τὰ ὕδατα ἃ εἶδες οὗ ἡ πόρνη κάθηται λαοὶ καὶ ὄχλοι εἰσὶν καὶ ἔθνη καὶ γλῶσσαι
verses.transliteration: Kai legei moi Ta hydata ha eides hou hē pornē kathētai laoi kai ochloi eisin kai ethnē kai glōssai
verses.literal: Then the angel said to me The waters you saw where the prostitute was seated are peoples and multitudes and nations and tongues
verses.literalPt: Disse-me: As águas que viste, sobre as quais está sentada a prostituta, são povos, multidões, nações e línguas.

verses.original: καὶ τὰ δέκα κέρατα ἃ εἶδες καὶ τὸ θηρίον οὗτοι μισήσουσιν τὴν πόρνην καὶ ἠρημωμένην ποιήσουσιν αὐτὴν καὶ γυμνήν καὶ τὰς σάρκας αὐτῆς φάγονται καὶ αὐτὴν κατακαύσουσιν ἐν πυρί
verses.transliteration: kai ta deka kerata ha eides kai to thērion houtoi misēsousin tēn pornēn kai ērēmōmenēn poiēsousin autēn kai gymnēn kai tas sarkas autēs phagontai kai autēn katakausousin en pyri
verses.literal: And the ten horns and the beast that you saw will hate the prostitute They will leave her desolate and naked and they will eat her flesh and burn her with fire
verses.literalPt: Os dez chifres que viste e a besta, estes odiarão a prostituta, e a farão desolada e nua, e comerão as suas carnes, e a queimarão no fogo.

verses.original: ὁ γὰρ Θεὸς ἔδωκεν εἰς τὰς καρδίας αὐτῶν ποιῆσαι τὴν γνώμην αὐτοῦ καὶ ποιῆσαι μίαν γνώμην καὶ δοῦναι τὴν βασιλείαν αὐτῶν τῷ θηρίῳ ἄχρι τελεσθήσονται οἱ λόγοι τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: ho gar Theos edōken eis tas kardias autōn poiēsai tēn gnōmēn autou kai poiēsai mian gnōmēn kai dounai tēn basileian autōn tō thēriō achri telesthēsontai hoi logoi tou Theou
verses.literal: For God has put it into their hearts to carry out His purpose by uniting to give their kingdom to the beast until the words of God are fulfilled
verses.literalPt: Pois Deus lhes pôs nos corações o executarem o que é do agrado dele, e o chegarem a um acordo, e entregarem o seu reino à besta, até que as palavras de Deus fossem cumpridas.

verses.original: καὶ ἡ γυνὴ ἣν εἶδες ἔστιν ἡ πόλις ἡ μεγάλη ἡ ἔχουσα βασιλείαν ἐπὶ τῶν βασιλέων τῆς γῆς
verses.transliteration: kai hē gynē hēn eides estin hē polis hē megalē hē echousa basileian epi tōn basileōn tēs gēs
verses.literal: And the woman you saw is the great city that rules over the kings of the earth
verses.literalPt: A mulher que viste é a grande cidade, que reina sobre os reis da terra.
